name: Data.card_GL_dvd_chosenGroupOrder
summary: Embed ∏ GL_n(𝔽_x) into ∏ GL_{r(D)t(D)}(𝔽_x) by g ↦ diag(g, 1) along an embedding n ↪ Fin(r(D)·t(D)); an injective homomorphism of finite groups has image of order dividing the order of the target (Lagrange).

steps.claim: By Lagrange (`Subgroup.card_dvd_of_injective`), the order of ∏_x GL_n(𝔽_x) divides that of ∏_x GL_{r(D)·t(D)}(𝔽_x), which is chosenGroupOrder, once an injective homomorphism between them is given.
steps.lean:
Subgroup.card_dvd_of_injective (.piMap fun _ ↦ extendGL (Function.Embedding.nonempty_of_card_le
  (by simpa)).some) (by simp [Function.Injective, funext_iff]; grind [extendGL_spec, Units.ext])

steps.claim: The homomorphism: at every chosen place x, g ↦ extendGL(u)(g) = 1 + ι(g − 1)ιᵀ, the block matrix diag(g, 1), along an embedding u : n ↪ Fin(r(D)·t(D)), which exists because #n ≤ r(D)·t(D) (h).
It is injective: the block of extendGL(u)(g) on u(n) × u(n) is g (`extendGL_spec`), so equal images have equal entries at every place.
